### Bible Pathways 03/17/2002
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-17-or-2002-1127510.html
Passage: Joshua 11:12
Points:
- God called Israel to execute judgment on the northern Canaanite coalition after generations of patience.
- Despite facing vast enemy forces equipped with chariots and cavalry, Joshua stood firm on God's promise of victory.
- Israel triumphed through wholehearted obedience, leaving nothing undone that the Lord commanded Moses.
- Victory was secured through reliance on divine strength rather than conventional military armaments.
- Believers are challenged to drive out entrenched spiritual enemies like bitterness and resentment through forgiveness.
